passage: The school added new equipment and an after-school schedule this fall. The number of students who signed up for the school's robotics program ______ doubled since last year.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: Find the true subject: "The number", which is singular. ("of students who signed up…" describes it.)
"Since last year" calls for present perfect tense.
Note: "A number of students have…" is plural, but "The number…has" is singular.
key: "The number of…" takes a singular verb; "A number of…" takes a plural verb.
